newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Freegold loses 30 kg gold output to fire.
newsitem.headline: Freegold loses 30 kg gold output to fire.

text.p: A fire at Free State Consolidated Gold Mines Ltd's Saaiplaas No 3 shaft had lost the mine about 30.0 kilograms of gold output, mine managers Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said in a statement on Monday.

It said the fire, which began on the night of October 6, was detected following two consecutive seismic events measuring 2.1 and 2.6 on the Richter scale, and forced the evacuation of the night shift from the mine.
Monday's shift was also cancelled while two chimneys in the affected area were established to eradicate smoke and the fire was brought under control. There were no casualties.
The company said that management was confident that the lost production could be made up during the course of the month.
Freegold produced 21,261 kg of gold in the second quarter to end June 1996.
